title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
abstract: arXiv:2607.24651v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable visual document understanding requires a model to attribute each answer to the evidence regions that support it. Recent benchmarks and systems express this step through a coordinate interface: the model outputs the coordinates of bounding boxes that mark the evidence regions in the document. Under this interface, vision-language models often fail to identify the right regions even when the answer is correct, a failure known as Attribution Hallucination. We present a study that investigates whether this failure is partially limited by what the model can express through coordinates. On a verified bilingual CiteVQA subset, we compare the coordinate interface with a language interface in which the model outputs only text, quoting its evidence verbatim, and a multimodal retriever returns the location of each quote as a page region proposed by a layout parser (tables and figures are quoted through their captions or notes); t

translated_title: 无需坐标或区域标签的视觉文档理解证据归因
translated_abstract: 可靠的视觉文档理解要求模型将每个答案归因于支持它的证据区域。近期的基准测试和系统通过坐标接口来表达这一步骤：模型输出标记文档中证据区域的边界框坐标。在此接口下，视觉语言模型即使答案正确，也常常无法识别正确的区域，这种失败被称为“归因幻觉”。我们开展了一项研究，探讨这种失败是否部分受限于模型通过坐标所能表达的内容。在一个经过验证的双语 CiteVQA 子集上，我们将坐标接口与语言接口进行对比：在语言接口中，模型仅输出文本，逐字引用其证据，随后由多模态检索器返回每条引用的位置，即布局解析器所提出的页面区域（表格和图片则通过其标题或注释进行引用）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究提出以“模型逐字引用证据、由多模态检索器定位出处”的语言接口替代传统的坐标边界框接口，表明视觉文档理解中的归因幻觉部分源于坐标表达能力的局限。
en_tdlr: This study replaces the coordinate bounding-box interface with a language interface where the model verbatim quotes its evidence and a multimodal retriever locates it, showing that Attribution Hallucination in visual document understanding is partly limited by what coordinates can express.
